title: A Rails database.yml is served
summary: The Rails database configuration is downloadable, which names the database and commonly carries its credentials.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_contains("adapter:") and (body_contains("password:") or body_contains("username:")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Block config files at the web server and rotate the database credentials.
